The actor who plays the father in **"I Can Only Imagine"** is **Dennis Quaid**, who portrayed Arthur Millard.

His wife was **Meg Ryan** (married 1991–2003), who is also an actress. She appeared in several notable films such as:

- *When Harry Met Sally* (1989)
- *Sleepless in Seattle* (1993)
- *You've Got Mail* (1998)

They divorced in 2003, and Dennis Quaid has since been married to Laura Savoie (since 2020).
